fusions.name: Heartrot
fusions.desc: Bores into the core of a target at or below 30% of its health, dealing 15 damage and using up every affliction on it to add 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Mycelial Bloom
fusions.desc: Spores rise through the soil from your roots, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Root-Net Sharing
fusions.desc: Pushes sap through the threads beneath you, restoring 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Fed on Rot
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, its rot feeds your roots: you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
